newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SHARES DIP AGAIN AS PLAYERS TAKE MORE PROFITS.
newsitem.headline: SHARES DIP AGAIN AS PLAYERS TAKE MORE PROFITS.

text.p: * Total trade by close 97.6 million kroons compared to 87.6
million kroons.
* Talse index slides 1.01 percent to 302.34.
* Hansapank was down 2.35 kroons to 168.90 kroons
in trade of 31.1 mln kroons.
* Hoiupank was lower to close 2.6 kroons down at
169.90 kroons in trade of 18.1 mln kroons.
* Forekspank was lower to close 0.1 kroons down at
199 kroons on trade of 11 million kroons.
(See the stock exchange web site: http://www.tse.ee/stat/)
Profit-taking in Hansapank and
Hoiupank brought the Tallinn bourse down on Monday after the
market had rallied to record highs last week.
Hansapank fell 2.35 kroons to 168.90 kroons and Hoiupank
lost 2.6 kroons to at 169.90 kroons in active trade.
"It is logical, rational behaviour as investors gained lots
of money during the last few days," a dealer said.
Both shares rose over 10 percent last week on the strength
of their six-months results.
Drugs firm Farmaatsiatehas was also active,
trading 4.94 million kroons to gain 1.35 kroons to 124.60.
On the free market, Norma was most active on 9.6
million kroons to be 0.35 kroons lower at 79.65 kroons.
Rakvere meat factory traded five million kroons to
gain 0.44 kroons to 14.10 kroons.
The three companies are due to announce their half-year
results soon.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201,
reuters@reuters.ee
